source.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed solid tumors with evidence of metastatic or locally advanced disease not amenable to standard therapy with curative intent.
Measurable disease as defined by RECIST version 1.1 by radiologic methods.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Central nervous system metastases that are untreated or symptomatic, or require radiation, surgery, or continued steroid therapy to control symptoms within 14 days of study entry.
Requirement for immunosuppressive medication (e.g. methotrexate, cyclophosphamide)
Patients with a history of interstitial lung disease (e.g., pneumonitis or pulmonary fibrosis) or evidence of ILD on baseline chest computerized tomography (CT) scan.

History of prior malignancies with the exception of excised cervical intraepithelial neoplasia or nonmelanoma skin cancer, or curatively treated cancer deemed at low risk for recurrence with no evidence of disease for 3 years.
No oncogenic missense mutations in KRAS, NRAS, BRAF, or EGFR ectodomain, and no HER2 (ERBB2) or KRAS amplification, as detected in plasma by ctDNA NGS central testing performed during screening.
No oncogenic missense mutations in KRAS, NRAS, BRAF, or EGFR ectodomain, and no HER2 (ERBB2) or KRAS amplification, as detected in plasma by ctDNA NGS central testing performed during screening.
patients who have progressed on or after, or are intolerant to, anti-PD-(L)1 therapy
progressed on or after, or are intolerant to, anti-PD-(L)1 therapy and platinum therapy as monotherapy or in combination with other agents
no previous exposure to EGFR inhibitors
tumors expressing programmed cell death protein ligand 1 (PD-L1), combined positive score (CPS) ≥1
patients should not have previous systemic therapy administered in the recurrent or metastatic setting
Previous treatments with anti PD-(L)1 or anti-EGFR therapies are not allowed.
Patients must be naive to prior anti-EGFR therapy.
